name: CanExport
eligibilitySummary: Federal grant to help Canadian businesses expand into international markets by covering export-related costs such as trade shows, market research, and business travel. Administered by Global Affairs Canada.

funding.description: Up to 75% of eligible export development costs for SMEs. Funding ranges from $3,000 to $75,000 per project.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be a registered Canadian business with at least 1 employee, operating for at least 1 year. Must demonstrate capacity to export and a concrete international market expansion plan.
